title: Stock In - Raw Material

purpose.en: Record Raw Material goods coming into a warehouse (regular receipt or opening balance) and post them to the Stock Card. Open it when goods arrive or to load an opening balance. Receipts auto-posted from supplier receiving also show here (Source PV).
purpose.id: Mencatat Bahan Baku yang masuk ke gudang (penerimaan biasa atau saldo awal) lalu memostingnya ke Kartu Stok. Buka saat barang datang atau memuat saldo awal. Penerimaan yang diposting otomatis dari penerimaan supplier juga tampil (Sumber PV).

keywords: stock in, barang masuk, penerimaan, saldo awal, opening balance, bb, in, Raw Material, Bahan Baku, bahan baku, raw material, rm

steps.en: The list shows Stock In documents of Raw Material. Use the search box (document no, reference, notes), the Draft / Waiting / Posted tabs or the column filters to find one.
steps.id: Daftar menampilkan dokumen Stock In Bahan Baku. Pakai kotak cari (no dokumen, referensi, catatan), tab Draft / Waiting / Posted atau filter kolom untuk mencarinya.

steps.en: Click + New Record to open an empty document. To change an existing draft, double-click its row or click Open.
steps.id: Klik + New Record untuk membuka dokumen kosong. Untuk mengubah draft yang ada, klik 2x barisnya atau klik Open.

steps.en: Fill Document Date, Document Category and Warehouse. Pick the Warehouse before the lines: the Location list of each line shows only usable locations of that warehouse.
steps.id: Isi Document Date, Document Category dan Warehouse. Pilih Warehouse sebelum baris item: daftar Location tiap baris hanya berisi lokasi yang bisa dipakai di gudang itu.

steps.en: Type at least 2 characters of the code or name in the item search box and click the result to add a line (the raw material comes from the Raw Material master). Repeat for every item.
steps.id: Ketik minimal 2 huruf kode atau nama di kotak cari item lalu klik hasilnya untuk menambah baris (bahan baku diambil dari master bahan baku). Ulangi untuk tiap item.

steps.en: On each line choose Location, enter Qty and, if needed, pick a Batch or choose + New batch and fill Supplier Lot and dates. Fill Unit Price. UoM is filled from the item.
steps.id: Di tiap baris pilih Location, isi Qty, dan bila perlu pilih Batch atau pilih + New batch lalu isi Supplier Lot dan tanggal. Isi Unit Price. UoM terisi dari item.

steps.en: Click Save Draft. The system gives the document its number. You can still edit the draft; Cancel cancels it.
steps.id: Klik Save Draft. Sistem memberi nomor dokumen. Draft masih bisa diubah; Cancel membatalkannya.

steps.en: Open the draft and click Confirm & Post (or the check icon in the list). The goods are added to the Stock Card and the document becomes read-only; fix mistakes later with a Stock Adjustment.
steps.id: Buka draft lalu klik Confirm & Post (atau ikon centang di daftar). Barang masuk ke Kartu Stok dan dokumen jadi hanya-baca; kesalahan dikoreksi lewat Stock Adjustment.

fields.label: Document No.
fields.en: Filled by the system when the draft is first saved. Not typed.
fields.id: Diisi sistem saat draft pertama disimpan. Tidak diketik.

fields.label: Document Date *
fields.en: Date the goods are received. Required. Starts as today.
fields.id: Tanggal barang diterima. Wajib. Awalnya hari ini.

fields.label: Document Category *
fields.en: STOCK (regular receipt) for normal incoming goods, BB (opening balance) to load the starting stock of an item. Required.
fields.id: STOCK (masuk biasa) untuk barang masuk normal, BB (saldo awal) untuk memuat stok awal item. Wajib.

fields.label: Warehouse *
fields.en: Receiving warehouse, picked from active warehouses in Warehouse & Location. Required. It decides which locations the lines can use.
fields.id: Gudang penerima, dipilih dari gudang aktif di Warehouse & Location. Wajib. Menentukan lokasi yang bisa dipakai baris.

fields.label: Received by
fields.en: Shows the logged-in user. Display only.
fields.id: Menampilkan user yang sedang login. Hanya tampilan.

fields.label: Notes
fields.en: Free text, for example delivery note number or remark. Shown under the document number in the list.
fields.id: Teks bebas, misalnya nomor surat jalan atau catatan. Tampil di bawah nomor dokumen pada daftar.

fields.label: Search item code / name to add…
fields.en: Search box to add a line. Type 2 or more characters; only active items of the Raw Material master are found (max 15 results).
fields.id: Kotak cari untuk menambah baris. Ketik 2 huruf atau lebih; hanya item aktif dari master bahan baku yang ditemukan (maks 15 hasil).

fields.label: Batch
fields.en: Optional. Pick an existing batch of the item (batch no, supplier lot, expiry) or + New batch. An item with a shelf life needs the expiry date of a new batch. The Stock Card keeps the lot.
fields.id: Opsional. Pilih batch item yang ada (no batch, lot supplier, kedaluwarsa) atau + New batch. Item berumur simpan wajib diisi tanggal kedaluwarsa batch baru. Kartu Stok menyimpan lotnya.

fields.label: Location *
fields.en: Storage location (bin) in the chosen warehouse where the goods are put. Required for every line.
fields.id: Lokasi simpan (bin) di gudang terpilih tempat barang ditaruh. Wajib di setiap baris.

fields.label: Qty *
fields.en: Quantity received, must be more than zero. Required.
fields.id: Jumlah yang diterima, harus lebih dari nol. Wajib.

fields.label: UoM
fields.en: Stock unit of the item, filled automatically.
fields.id: Satuan stok item, terisi otomatis.

fields.label: Unit Price
fields.en: Price per unit of the received goods (default 0). Used to value the stock and its average price.
fields.id: Harga per satuan barang yang diterima (default 0). Dipakai untuk menilai stok dan harga rata-ratanya.

title: Stock Out - Raw Material

purpose.en: Record Raw Material issued out of a warehouse to a department or process (for example to production) and post it to the Stock Card. Open it when goods are handed over from the warehouse.
purpose.id: Mencatat Bahan Baku yang dikeluarkan dari gudang ke departemen atau proses (misalnya ke produksi) lalu memostingnya ke Kartu Stok. Buka saat barang diserahkan dari gudang.

keywords: stock out, barang keluar, pengeluaran, issue, serah terima, ke produksi, out, Raw Material, Bahan Baku, bahan baku, raw material, rm

steps.en: The list shows Stock Out documents of this stock class. Search by document no or notes, or use the Draft / Waiting / Posted tabs and column filters.
steps.id: Daftar menampilkan dokumen Stock Out kelas stok ini. Cari dengan no dokumen atau catatan, atau pakai tab Draft / Waiting / Posted dan filter kolom.

steps.en: Click + New Record (or double-click a draft to edit it).
steps.id: Klik + New Record (atau klik 2x draft untuk mengubahnya).

steps.en: Fill Document Date, Source Warehouse and Issued To (Dept.). Target Process is optional text. Pick the warehouse first so the line locations can be chosen.
steps.id: Isi Document Date, Source Warehouse dan Issued To (Dept.). Target Process teks opsional. Pilih gudang dulu agar lokasi baris bisa dipilih.

steps.en: Search the raw material by code or name (2 or more characters) and click the result to add a line; repeat for each item.
steps.id: Cari bahan baku dengan kode atau nama (2 huruf atau lebih) lalu klik hasilnya untuk menambah baris; ulangi untuk tiap item.

steps.en: For each line choose Source Location and enter Qty Out and, if needed, Lot/Batch.
steps.id: Di tiap baris pilih Source Location dan isi Qty Out, serta Lot/Batch bila perlu.

steps.en: Click Save Draft, then open the draft and click Confirm & Post (or the check icon in the list). The goods leave the Stock Card and the document becomes read-only.
steps.id: Klik Save Draft, lalu buka draft dan klik Confirm & Post (atau ikon centang di daftar). Barang keluar dari Kartu Stok dan dokumen jadi hanya-baca.

steps.en: If the item has no cost/inventory account, a notice tells you which master to complete. Wrong document? Cancel a draft, or correct a posted one with Stock Adjustment.
steps.id: Bila item belum punya akun HPP/persediaan, muncul peringatan master mana yang harus dilengkapi. Salah dokumen? Cancel draft, atau koreksi yang sudah posting lewat Stock Adjustment.

fields.label: Document No.
fields.en: Filled by the system when the draft is first saved.
fields.id: Diisi sistem saat draft pertama disimpan.

fields.label: Document Date *
fields.en: Date the goods are issued. Required. Starts as today.
fields.id: Tanggal barang dikeluarkan. Wajib. Awalnya hari ini.

fields.label: Source Warehouse *
fields.en: Warehouse the goods are taken from, picked from active warehouses. Required.
fields.id: Gudang asal barang, dipilih dari gudang aktif. Wajib.

fields.label: Issued To (Dept.) *
fields.en: Department that receives the goods, picked from the department master. Required.
fields.id: Departemen penerima barang, dipilih dari master departemen. Wajib.

fields.label: Target Process
fields.en: Free text for the process the goods go to, for example Offset Printing or Lamination. Optional.
fields.id: Teks bebas untuk proses tujuan barang, misalnya Cetak Offset atau Laminasi. Opsional.

fields.label: Issued by
fields.en: Shows the logged-in user. Display only.
fields.id: Menampilkan user yang sedang login. Hanya tampilan.

fields.label: Notes
fields.en: Free text remark, shown under the document number in the list.
fields.id: Catatan bebas, tampil di bawah nomor dokumen pada daftar.

fields.label: Search code / name of raw material to add…
fields.en: Search box to add a line. Type 2 or more characters; only active items of the Raw Material master are found.
fields.id: Kotak cari untuk menambah baris. Ketik 2 huruf atau lebih; hanya item aktif dari master bahan baku yang ditemukan.

fields.label: Lot/Batch
fields.en: Optional lot or batch number of the goods taken.
fields.id: Nomor lot atau batch barang yang diambil (opsional).

fields.label: Source Location *
fields.en: Storage location (bin) the goods are taken from, limited to usable locations of the source warehouse. Required.
fields.id: Lokasi simpan (bin) asal barang, terbatas pada lokasi yang bisa dipakai di gudang sumber. Wajib.

fields.label: Qty Out *
fields.en: Quantity issued, must be more than zero. Required.
fields.id: Jumlah yang dikeluarkan, harus lebih dari nol. Wajib.

fields.label: UoM
fields.en: Stock unit of the item, filled automatically.
fields.id: Satuan stok item, terisi otomatis.

title: Return from Production - Raw Material

purpose.en: Bring Raw Material back to the warehouse after production did not use it, either in good condition or as scrap. A return always refers to a posted Stock Out and can never be more than what is left of it.
purpose.id: Mengembalikan Bahan Baku ke gudang setelah produksi tidak memakainya, dalam kondisi layak atau afkir. Retur selalu mengacu ke Stock Out yang sudah posting dan tidak boleh melebihi sisanya.

keywords: return from production, retur produksi, retur, kembali ke gudang, afkir, scrap, sisa bahan, Raw Material, Bahan Baku, bahan baku, raw material, rm

steps.en: The list shows return documents of this stock class. Search by document no or Stock Out no, or use the Draft / Waiting / Posted tabs and column filters.
steps.id: Daftar menampilkan dokumen retur kelas stok ini. Cari dengan no dokumen atau no Stock Out, atau pakai tab Draft / Waiting / Posted dan filter kolom.

steps.en: Click + New Record. Fill Tanggal Dokumen and click the dashed Ref. Stock Out box to open the list of Stock Out documents that can still be returned.
steps.id: Klik + New Record. Isi Tanggal Dokumen lalu klik kotak putus-putus Ref. Stock Out untuk membuka daftar Stock Out yang masih bisa diretur.

steps.en: Click a Stock Out. Its lines are copied in with Dikeluarkan and Sisa Boleh (what may still be returned). Choose Gudang Purpose (bahan layak).
steps.id: Klik satu Stock Out. Baris-barisnya disalin lengkap dengan Dikeluarkan dan Sisa Boleh (yang masih boleh diretur). Pilih Gudang Purpose (bahan layak).

steps.en: On each line enter Qty Retur, choose Kondisi (GOOD or SCRAP) and Lokasi Purpose. Lines you do not return must not stay with a quantity.
steps.id: Di tiap baris isi Qty Retur, pilih Kondisi (GOOD atau SCRAP) dan Lokasi Purpose. Baris yang tidak diretur jangan dibiarkan berisi jumlah.

steps.en: For SCRAP lines Keterangan is required. Click Save Draft, then open the draft and click Confirm & Post.
steps.id: Untuk baris SCRAP, Keterangan wajib diisi. Klik Save Draft, lalu buka draft dan klik Confirm & Post.

steps.en: After posting the goods are added back to the Stock Card and the returned quantity is counted on the Stock Out. The document is read-only; Cancel works only on a draft.
steps.id: Setelah posting barang masuk lagi ke Kartu Stok dan jumlah retur tercatat di Stock Out. Dokumen jadi hanya-baca; Cancel hanya untuk draft.

fields.label: Doc No.
fields.en: Filled by the system when the draft is first saved.
fields.id: Diisi sistem saat draft pertama disimpan.

fields.label: Document Date *
fields.en: Date of the return. Required. Starts as today.
fields.id: Tanggal retur. Wajib. Awalnya hari ini.

fields.label: Ref. Stock Out *
fields.en: The posted, not cancelled Stock Out being returned, picked from the list of Stock Outs with a remaining returnable quantity. Fixed once saved. Required.
fields.id: Stock Out yang sudah posting dan tidak dibatalkan yang diretur, dipilih dari daftar Stock Out yang masih punya sisa retur. Tidak bisa diganti setelah disimpan. Wajib.

fields.label: Destination Warehouse (usable goods) *
fields.en: Warehouse that receives the returned goods. Good-condition lines can only use its usable locations. Required.
fields.id: Gudang penerima barang retur. Baris kondisi layak hanya bisa memakai lokasi yang bisa dipakai di gudang ini. Wajib.

fields.label: Source Process
fields.en: Process the goods came back from. Filled from the Stock Out, can be changed. Optional.
fields.id: Proses asal barang kembali. Terisi dari Stock Out, bisa diubah. Opsional.

fields.label: Notes
fields.en: Free text remark.
fields.id: Catatan bebas.

fields.label: Item
fields.en: Item of the line, copied from the Stock Out.
fields.id: Item baris, disalin dari Stock Out.

fields.label: Issued
fields.en: Quantity issued on the Stock Out line.
fields.id: Jumlah yang dikeluarkan pada baris Stock Out.

fields.label: Returnable
fields.en: Quantity that may still be returned (issued minus earlier returns). Qty Retur cannot go above it.
fields.id: Jumlah yang masih boleh diretur (dikeluarkan dikurangi retur sebelumnya). Qty Retur tidak boleh melebihinya.

fields.label: Return Qty *
fields.en: Quantity coming back, more than zero and not above Sisa Boleh. Required. The row turns red when too high.
fields.id: Jumlah yang kembali, lebih dari nol dan tidak lebih dari Sisa Boleh. Wajib. Baris menjadi merah bila kelebihan.

fields.label: Condition *
fields.en: GOOD (Layak) goes back to a usable location. SCRAP (Afkir) goes to a location that is not usable, for example a waste bin.
fields.id: GOOD (Layak) kembali ke lokasi yang bisa dipakai. SCRAP (Afkir) ke lokasi yang tidak bisa dipakai, misalnya bin waste.

fields.label: Destination Location *
fields.en: Location that receives the goods. The list changes with Kondisi. Required.
fields.id: Lokasi penerima barang. Daftarnya berubah sesuai Kondisi. Wajib.

fields.label: Description
fields.en: Reason for the line. Required for SCRAP lines, optional for GOOD.
fields.id: Alasan untuk baris. Wajib untuk baris SCRAP, opsional untuk GOOD.

title: Stock Adjustment & Physical Count - Raw Material
title_id: Stock Adjustment & Hitung Fisik - Bahan Baku

purpose.en: Correct the system balance of Raw Material to the real quantity: a single Adjustment, or a scheduled Stock Opname (physical count). It always needs approval; the stock only changes when the last approver approves.
purpose.id: Mengoreksi saldo sistem Bahan Baku agar sama dengan jumlah sebenarnya: Adjustment tunggal atau Stock Opname (hitung fisik) terjadwal. Selalu perlu persetujuan; stok baru berubah setelah approver terakhir menyetujui.

keywords: stock adjustment, opname, stock opname, hitung fisik, koreksi stok, selisih stok, penyesuaian stok, adj, op, ad, Raw Material, Bahan Baku

steps.en: The list shows Adjustment and Opname documents of this stock class with their status. Search by document no or notes, or use the status tabs and filters.
steps.id: Daftar menampilkan dokumen Adjustment dan Opname kelas stok ini beserta statusnya. Cari dengan no dokumen atau catatan, atau pakai tab status dan filter.

steps.en: Click + New Record. Choose Kind (Adjustment or Stock Opname), Document Date, Warehouse and Reason. For Stock Opname also fill the Opname Block: officer, count start and end, witness.
steps.id: Klik + New Record. Pilih Kind (Adjustment atau Stock Opname), Document Date, Warehouse dan Reason. Untuk Stock Opname isi juga Blok Opname: petugas, mulai dan selesai hitung, saksi.

steps.en: Add lines: search the raw material (2 or more characters) and click it. For a full count tick Full Scope and click Pull All Items With Balance to load every item that has stock in the warehouse.
steps.id: Tambah baris: cari bahan baku (2 huruf atau lebih) lalu klik. Untuk hitung penuh centang Full Scope dan klik Pull All Items With Balance untuk memuat semua item yang punya stok di gudang.

steps.en: On each line choose Location: System Balance and the price are loaded from the last Stock Card entry. Type the counted quantity in Physical Count; Variance and Variance Value are calculated.
steps.id: Di tiap baris pilih Location: System Balance dan harga dimuat dari catatan terakhir Kartu Stok. Ketik jumlah hasil hitung di Physical Count; Variance dan Variance Value dihitung otomatis.

steps.en: Click Save Draft. When the lines are final, click Submit for Approval. The lines are locked while approval runs.
steps.id: Klik Save Draft. Setelah baris final, klik Submit for Approval. Baris terkunci selama proses persetujuan.

steps.en: Approvers decide in Adjustment Approval. When the last level approves, the document is posted to the Stock Card. If rejected, the status becomes REVISION_NEEDED: fix it and submit again.
steps.id: Approver memutuskan di Adjustment Approval. Saat level terakhir menyetujui, dokumen diposting ke Kartu Stok. Bila ditolak, status menjadi REVISION_NEEDED: perbaiki lalu ajukan lagi.

fields.label: Document No.
fields.en: Filled by the system when the draft is first saved (ADJ for Adjustment, OPN for Opname).
fields.id: Diisi sistem saat draft pertama disimpan (ADJ untuk Adjustment, OPN untuk Opname).

fields.label: Document Date *
fields.en: Date of the correction or count. Required. Starts as today.
fields.id: Tanggal koreksi atau hitung. Wajib. Awalnya hari ini.

fields.label: Kind *
fields.en: Adjustment (single correction) or Stock Opname (scheduled physical count). Cannot be changed after the first save.
fields.id: Adjustment (koreksi tunggal) atau Stock Opname (hitung fisik terjadwal). Tidak bisa diubah setelah disimpan pertama kali.

fields.label: Warehouse *
fields.en: Warehouse being corrected or counted. Required.
fields.id: Gudang yang dikoreksi atau dihitung. Wajib.

fields.label: Reason *
fields.en: Why the balance differs: previous counting/input error, damaged, lost, found (more than recorded), expired or other. Required.
fields.id: Mengapa saldo berbeda: salah hitung/input sebelumnya, rusak, hilang, ditemukan (lebih dari catatan), kadaluarsa atau lainnya. Wajib.

fields.label: Submitted by
fields.en: Shows the logged-in user. Display only.
fields.id: Menampilkan user yang sedang login. Hanya tampilan.

fields.label: Opname Officer *
fields.en: Name of the person who counts. Required for Stock Opname only.
fields.id: Nama petugas yang menghitung. Wajib hanya untuk Stock Opname.

fields.label: Count Start *
fields.en: Date and time the count started. Required for Stock Opname.
fields.id: Tanggal dan jam hitung mulai. Wajib untuk Stock Opname.

fields.label: Count End *
fields.en: Date and time the count finished. Required for Stock Opname.
fields.id: Tanggal dan jam hitung selesai. Wajib untuk Stock Opname.

fields.label: Witness *
fields.en: Name of the person who witnesses the count. Required for Stock Opname.
fields.id: Nama saksi hitung. Wajib untuk Stock Opname.

fields.label: Full Scope (all items with balance)
fields.en: Tick when every item in the warehouse is counted; it shows the button Pull All Items With Balance that loads all items with a balance. Stock Opname only.
fields.id: Centang bila semua item di gudang dihitung; muncul tombol Pull All Items With Balance yang memuat semua item bersaldo. Hanya Stock Opname.

fields.label: Notes / Chronology
fields.en: Free text: what happened and how the difference was found.
fields.id: Teks bebas: apa yang terjadi dan bagaimana selisih ditemukan.

fields.label: Location *
fields.en: Location of the counted stock. Choosing it loads System Balance and the price for that item and location. Required.
fields.id: Lokasi stok yang dihitung. Memilihnya memuat System Balance dan harga item di lokasi itu. Wajib.

fields.label: System Balance
fields.en: Quantity the system says is there (from the last Stock Card entry). Display only.
fields.id: Jumlah menurut sistem (dari catatan terakhir Kartu Stok). Hanya tampilan.

fields.label: Physical Count *
fields.en: The real quantity counted, zero or more. Type the counted total, not the difference. Required.
fields.id: Jumlah nyata hasil hitung, nol atau lebih. Ketik total hasil hitung, bukan selisihnya. Wajib.

fields.label: Variance
fields.en: Physical Count minus System Balance, calculated. Plus means more than recorded, minus means less.
fields.id: Physical Count dikurangi System Balance, dihitung otomatis. Plus berarti lebih dari catatan, minus berarti kurang.

fields.label: Variance Value
fields.en: Absolute value of the variance times the unit price, calculated. The total decides how many approval levels are needed.
fields.id: Nilai mutlak selisih dikali harga satuan, dihitung otomatis. Totalnya menentukan jumlah level persetujuan.

fields.label: Line Reason
fields.en: Remark per line; the screen marks it required when there is a variance. It is a reminder on the screen and is not saved with the document.
fields.id: Catatan per baris; layar menandainya wajib bila ada selisih. Hanya pengingat di layar dan tidak disimpan bersama dokumen.

fields.label: Rejection Reason
fields.en: Shown to the approver only: required when rejecting, at least 10 characters.
fields.id: Hanya untuk approver: wajib saat menolak, minimal 10 karakter.

title: Stock Balance - Raw Material

purpose.en: Shows how much Raw Material is on hand now, one row per item and location, with this month's opening, in, out and adjustment. Open it to check stock, value and items below minimum.
purpose.id: Menampilkan jumlah Bahan Baku yang ada sekarang, satu baris per item dan lokasi, beserta awal, masuk, keluar dan penyesuaian bulan ini. Buka untuk cek stok, nilai dan item di bawah minimum.

keywords: stock balance, saldo stok, stok, on hand, persediaan, master stock, minimum stock, stok minimum, nilai stok, laporan stok, Raw Material, Bahan Baku

steps.en: Open the report; it lists all stock now. Type in the search box (item code or name) to find an item.
steps.id: Buka laporan; isinya semua stok saat ini. Ketik di kotak cari (kode atau nama item) untuk menemukan item.

steps.en: Click a tab (Below minimum, Empty, Not usable) to see only those rows, or All to see everything.
steps.id: Klik tab (Below minimum, Empty, Not usable) untuk melihat baris tertentu saja, atau All untuk semuanya.

steps.en: Use the filters Category, Warehouse, Location and Stock to narrow the list.
steps.id: Pakai filter Category, Warehouse, Location dan Stock untuk mempersempit daftar.

steps.en: Group by Category, Warehouse or Item to get subtotals. Number and value columns show totals.
steps.id: Kelompokkan menurut Category, Warehouse atau Item untuk mendapat subtotal. Kolom jumlah dan nilai menampilkan total.

steps.en: Use the column chooser to show Minimum Stock and Idle (days), which are hidden at first. Open the Stock Card report to see the movements behind a balance.
steps.id: Pakai pemilih kolom untuk menampilkan Minimum Stock dan Idle (days) yang awalnya tersembunyi. Buka laporan Stock Card untuk melihat mutasi di balik saldo.

fields.label: Item
fields.en: Item name with its code.
fields.id: Nama item beserta kodenya.

fields.label: Category
fields.en: Group of the item: the category of the raw material.
fields.id: Kelompok item: kategori bahan baku.

fields.label: Warehouse
fields.en: Warehouse holding the stock.
fields.id: Gudang tempat stok berada.

fields.label: Location
fields.en: Storage location (bin) in that warehouse.
fields.id: Lokasi simpan (bin) di gudang itu.

fields.label: Opening
fields.en: Quantity at the start of the current month. If the item had no movement this month it equals On Hand.
fields.id: Jumlah di awal bulan berjalan. Bila item tidak bergerak bulan ini, nilainya sama dengan On Hand.

fields.label: In
fields.en: Total received this month.
fields.id: Total masuk bulan ini.

fields.label: Out
fields.en: Total issued this month.
fields.id: Total keluar bulan ini.

fields.label: Adjustment
fields.en: Total of adjustments and opname corrections this month (can be negative).
fields.id: Total penyesuaian dan koreksi opname bulan ini (bisa negatif).

fields.label: On Hand
fields.en: Quantity in the warehouse now.
fields.id: Jumlah di gudang sekarang.

fields.label: Unit
fields.en: Stock unit.
fields.id: Satuan stok.

fields.label: Minimum Stock
fields.en: Minimum stock set on the item master. Hidden at first.
fields.id: Stok minimum yang diatur di master item. Awalnya tersembunyi.

fields.label: Stock Value
fields.en: Value of the stock in that row.
fields.id: Nilai stok pada baris itu.

fields.label: Last Movement
fields.en: Date of the latest movement of that item in that location.
fields.id: Tanggal mutasi terakhir item di lokasi itu.

fields.label: Idle (days)
fields.en: Days since the last movement. Hidden at first.
fields.id: Jumlah hari sejak mutasi terakhir. Awalnya tersembunyi.

fields.label: Stock
fields.en: Status: OK, Below minimum (usable stock of the item is under its minimum), Empty, or Not usable (location cannot be used, e.g. waste).
fields.id: Status: OK, Below minimum (stok bisa pakai item di bawah minimum), Empty, atau Not usable (lokasi tidak bisa dipakai, mis. waste).

fields.label: Filter: Category / Warehouse / Location / Stock
fields.en: Narrow the rows by item group, warehouse, location or stock status.
fields.id: Mempersempit baris menurut kelompok item, gudang, lokasi atau status stok.

fields.label: Group by: Category / Warehouse / Item
fields.en: Gather the rows under headings with subtotals.
fields.id: Mengelompokkan baris di bawah judul dengan subtotal.

title: Stock Card - Raw Material

purpose.en: Lists every stock movement of Raw Material, newest first: what came in, went out or was adjusted, in which document and location, and the balance after it. Open it to trace why a balance is what it is.
purpose.id: Menampilkan setiap mutasi stok Bahan Baku, terbaru di atas: apa yang masuk, keluar atau disesuaikan, di dokumen dan lokasi mana, serta saldo sesudahnya. Buka untuk menelusuri asal sebuah saldo.

keywords: stock card, kartu stok, mutasi stok, riwayat stok, movement, history stok, kartu persediaan, laporan stok, Raw Material, Bahan Baku

steps.en: Open the report; all movements are listed, newest first.
steps.id: Buka laporan; semua mutasi tampil, terbaru di atas.

steps.en: To read the card of one item, type its code or name (or a document or reference number) in the search box, or group by Item.
steps.id: Untuk membaca kartu satu item, ketik kode atau namanya (atau no dokumen atau referensi) di kotak cari, atau kelompokkan menurut Item.

steps.en: Click a tab (In, Out, Adjustment) to see only that kind of movement.
steps.id: Klik tab (In, Out, Adjustment) untuk melihat satu jenis mutasi saja.

steps.en: Use the filters Movement, Category, Warehouse and Location, or group by Warehouse or Movement.
steps.id: Pakai filter Movement, Category, Warehouse dan Location, atau kelompokkan menurut Warehouse atau Movement.

steps.en: Read BB, the movement and EB on the same row. BB is the balance of the item in all locations before the row; EB is BB + In - Out + Adjustment and is the BB of the next row.
steps.id: Baca BB, mutasi dan EB pada baris yang sama. BB = saldo item di semua lokasi sebelum baris; EB = BB + In - Out + Adjustment dan menjadi BB baris berikutnya.

fields.label: Date
fields.en: Date of the document.
fields.id: Tanggal dokumen.

fields.label: Doc No.
fields.en: Number of the stock document that caused the movement.
fields.id: Nomor dokumen stok yang menyebabkan mutasi.

fields.label: Movement
fields.en: Kind of movement: In, Out, Adjustment, Transfer in, Transfer out or Opening.
fields.id: Jenis mutasi: In, Out, Adjustment, Transfer in, Transfer out, atau Opening.

fields.label: Category
fields.en: Document category code (for example STOCK, BB, AD, OP, RETURN). Hidden at first.
fields.id: Kode kategori dokumen (misalnya STOCK, BB, AD, OP, RETURN). Awalnya tersembunyi.

fields.label: Item
fields.en: Item name with its code.
fields.id: Nama item beserta kodenya.

fields.label: Warehouse
fields.en: Warehouse of the movement.
fields.id: Gudang tempat mutasi.

fields.label: Location
fields.en: Storage location (bin).
fields.id: Lokasi simpan (bin).

fields.label: Lot No.
fields.en: Lot or batch number. Hidden at first.
fields.id: Nomor lot atau batch. Awalnya tersembunyi.

fields.label: Reference
fields.en: Number of the source document, for example the receiving or the Stock Out it came from.
fields.id: Nomor dokumen sumber, misalnya penerimaan atau Stock Out asalnya.

fields.label: BB
fields.en: Balance of the item in all locations just before the movement. It equals the EB of the row before it.
fields.id: Saldo item di semua lokasi tepat sebelum mutasi. Sama dengan EB baris sebelumnya.

fields.label: In
fields.en: Quantity received.
fields.id: Jumlah masuk.

fields.label: Out
fields.en: Quantity issued.
fields.id: Jumlah keluar.

fields.label: Adjustment
fields.en: Quantity added or removed by an adjustment (can be negative).
fields.id: Jumlah yang ditambah atau dikurangi oleh penyesuaian (bisa negatif).

fields.label: EB
fields.en: Balance of the item in all locations right after the movement: BB + In - Out + Adjustment.
fields.id: Saldo item di semua lokasi sesudah mutasi: BB + In - Out + Adjustment.

fields.label: Location Opening
fields.en: Balance of that item in that one location just before the movement. Hidden at first.
fields.id: Saldo item di satu lokasi itu tepat sebelum mutasi. Awalnya tersembunyi.

fields.label: Location Balance
fields.en: Balance of that item in that one location right after the movement. Hidden at first.
fields.id: Saldo item di satu lokasi itu sesudah mutasi. Awalnya tersembunyi.

fields.label: Unit
fields.en: Stock unit.
fields.id: Satuan stok.

fields.label: Filter: Movement / Category / Warehouse / Location
fields.en: Narrow the rows by kind of movement, document category, warehouse or location.
fields.id: Mempersempit baris menurut jenis mutasi, kategori dokumen, gudang atau lokasi.

fields.label: Group by: Item / Warehouse / Movement
fields.en: Gather the rows under headings. Group by Item to read one item as a card.
fields.id: Mengelompokkan baris di bawah judul. Kelompokkan menurut Item untuk membaca satu item sebagai kartu.

title: Slow Moving Item - Raw Material

purpose.en: Lists Raw Material items that still have usable stock but have not moved for 3 months or more, so you can decide to use, sell or write them off. Open it during stock review.
purpose.id: Menampilkan item Bahan Baku yang masih punya stok bisa pakai tetapi tidak bergerak 3 bulan atau lebih, agar bisa diputuskan dipakai, dijual atau dihapus. Buka saat evaluasi stok.

keywords: slow moving, slow moving item, stok mati, barang tidak bergerak, dead stock, stok lama, idle, tidak laku, laporan stok, Raw Material, Bahan Baku

steps.en: Open the report; items with no movement for 3 months or more are listed, longest idle first.
steps.id: Buka laporan; item yang tidak bergerak 3 bulan atau lebih tampil, yang paling lama diam di atas.

steps.en: Click a tab (3-6 months, 6-9 months, 9-12 months, Over 12 months, Never moved) to see one age band.
steps.id: Klik tab (3-6 months, 6-9 months, 9-12 months, Over 12 months, Never moved) untuk melihat satu rentang usia.

steps.en: Use the search box (item code or name), the filters Category and Idle, or group by Category or Idle.
steps.id: Pakai kotak cari (kode atau nama item), filter Category dan Idle, atau kelompokkan menurut Category atau Idle.

steps.en: Check On Hand, Stock Value and Last Movement, then follow up with the warehouse or purchasing. The totals show how much value is tied up.
steps.id: Cek On Hand, Stock Value dan Last Movement, lalu tindak lanjuti bersama gudang atau pembelian. Total menunjukkan nilai yang tertahan.

fields.label: Item
fields.en: Item name with its code. Each item appears once, even when it is in several locations.
fields.id: Nama item beserta kodenya. Tiap item tampil sekali, walau ada di beberapa lokasi.

fields.label: Category
fields.en: Group of the item: the category of the raw material.
fields.id: Kelompok item: kategori bahan baku.

fields.label: Warehouse
fields.en: All warehouses where the item has usable stock.
fields.id: Semua gudang tempat item punya stok bisa pakai.

fields.label: On Hand
fields.en: Total usable quantity of the item.
fields.id: Total jumlah item yang bisa dipakai.

fields.label: Unit
fields.en: Stock unit.
fields.id: Satuan stok.

fields.label: Stock Value
fields.en: Value of that stock.
fields.id: Nilai stok itu.

fields.label: Last Movement
fields.en: Date of the latest movement of the item in any location. Empty for old balances without a date.
fields.id: Tanggal mutasi terakhir item di lokasi mana pun. Kosong untuk saldo lama tanpa tanggal.

fields.label: Idle (days)
fields.en: Days since the last movement.
fields.id: Jumlah hari sejak mutasi terakhir.

fields.label: Idle
fields.en: Age band: 3-6 months, 6-9 months, 9-12 months, Over 12 months, or Never moved (old balance without a movement date).
fields.id: Rentang usia: 3-6 months, 6-9 months, 9-12 months, Over 12 months, atau Never moved (saldo lama tanpa tanggal mutasi).

fields.label: Filter: Category / Idle
fields.en: Narrow the rows by item group or age band.
fields.id: Mempersempit baris menurut kelompok item atau rentang usia.

fields.label: Group by: Category / Idle
fields.en: Gather the rows under headings with subtotals.
fields.id: Mengelompokkan baris di bawah judul dengan subtotal.

title: Stock In - Finished Goods

purpose.en: Record Finished Goods goods coming into a warehouse (regular receipt or opening balance) and post them to the Stock Card. Open it when goods arrive or to load an opening balance. Documents here are entered by hand (Source MANUAL).
purpose.id: Mencatat Barang Jadi yang masuk ke gudang (penerimaan biasa atau saldo awal) lalu memostingnya ke Kartu Stok. Buka saat barang datang atau memuat saldo awal. Dokumen di sini diinput manual (Sumber MANUAL).

keywords: stock in, barang masuk, penerimaan, saldo awal, opening balance, bb, in, Finished Goods, Barang Jadi, barang jadi, finished goods, fg

steps.en: The list shows Stock In documents of Finished Goods. Use the search box (document no, reference, notes), the Draft / Waiting / Posted tabs or the column filters to find one.
steps.id: Daftar menampilkan dokumen Stock In Barang Jadi. Pakai kotak cari (no dokumen, referensi, catatan), tab Draft / Waiting / Posted atau filter kolom untuk mencarinya.

steps.en: Click + New Record to open an empty document. To change an existing draft, double-click its row or click Open.
steps.id: Klik + New Record untuk membuka dokumen kosong. Untuk mengubah draft yang ada, klik 2x barisnya atau klik Open.

steps.en: Fill Document Date, Document Category and Warehouse. Pick the Warehouse before the lines: the Location list of each line shows only usable locations of that warehouse.
steps.id: Isi Document Date, Document Category dan Warehouse. Pilih Warehouse sebelum baris item: daftar Location tiap baris hanya berisi lokasi yang bisa dipakai di gudang itu.

steps.en: Type at least 2 characters of the code or name in the item search box and click the result to add a line (the product comes from the Master Product). Repeat for every item.
steps.id: Ketik minimal 2 huruf kode atau nama di kotak cari item lalu klik hasilnya untuk menambah baris (produk diambil dari Master Product). Ulangi untuk tiap item.

steps.en: On each line choose Location, enter Qty and, if needed, pick a Batch or choose + New batch and fill Supplier Lot and dates. Fill Unit Price. UoM is filled from the item.
steps.id: Di tiap baris pilih Location, isi Qty, dan bila perlu pilih Batch atau pilih + New batch lalu isi Supplier Lot dan tanggal. Isi Unit Price. UoM terisi dari item.

steps.en: Click Save Draft. The system gives the document its number. You can still edit the draft; Cancel cancels it.
steps.id: Klik Save Draft. Sistem memberi nomor dokumen. Draft masih bisa diubah; Cancel membatalkannya.

steps.en: Open the draft and click Confirm & Post (or the check icon in the list). The goods are added to the Stock Card and the document becomes read-only; fix mistakes later with a Stock Adjustment.
steps.id: Buka draft lalu klik Confirm & Post (atau ikon centang di daftar). Barang masuk ke Kartu Stok dan dokumen jadi hanya-baca; kesalahan dikoreksi lewat Stock Adjustment.

fields.label: Document No.
fields.en: Filled by the system when the draft is first saved. Not typed.
fields.id: Diisi sistem saat draft pertama disimpan. Tidak diketik.

fields.label: Document Date *
fields.en: Date the goods are received. Required. Starts as today.
fields.id: Tanggal barang diterima. Wajib. Awalnya hari ini.

fields.label: Document Category *
fields.en: STOCK (regular receipt) for normal incoming goods, BB (opening balance) to load the starting stock of an item. Required.
fields.id: STOCK (masuk biasa) untuk barang masuk normal, BB (saldo awal) untuk memuat stok awal item. Wajib.

fields.label: Warehouse *
fields.en: Receiving warehouse, picked from active warehouses in Warehouse & Location. Required. It decides which locations the lines can use.
fields.id: Gudang penerima, dipilih dari gudang aktif di Warehouse & Location. Wajib. Menentukan lokasi yang bisa dipakai baris.

fields.label: Received by
fields.en: Shows the logged-in user. Display only.
fields.id: Menampilkan user yang sedang login. Hanya tampilan.

fields.label: Notes
fields.en: Free text, for example delivery note number or remark. Shown under the document number in the list.
fields.id: Teks bebas, misalnya nomor surat jalan atau catatan. Tampil di bawah nomor dokumen pada daftar.

fields.label: Search item code / name to add…
fields.en: Search box to add a line. Type 2 or more characters; only active items of the Master Product are found (max 15 results).
fields.id: Kotak cari untuk menambah baris. Ketik 2 huruf atau lebih; hanya item aktif dari Master Product yang ditemukan (maks 15 hasil).

fields.label: Batch
fields.en: Optional. Pick an existing batch of the item (batch no, supplier lot, expiry) or + New batch. An item with a shelf life needs the expiry date of a new batch. The Stock Card keeps the lot.
fields.id: Opsional. Pilih batch item yang ada (no batch, lot supplier, kedaluwarsa) atau + New batch. Item berumur simpan wajib diisi tanggal kedaluwarsa batch baru. Kartu Stok menyimpan lotnya.

fields.label: Location *
fields.en: Storage location (bin) in the chosen warehouse where the goods are put. Required for every line.
fields.id: Lokasi simpan (bin) di gudang terpilih tempat barang ditaruh. Wajib di setiap baris.

fields.label: Qty *
fields.en: Quantity received, must be more than zero. Required.
fields.id: Jumlah yang diterima, harus lebih dari nol. Wajib.

fields.label: UoM
fields.en: Stock unit of the item, filled automatically.
fields.id: Satuan stok item, terisi otomatis.

fields.label: Unit Price
fields.en: Price per unit of the received goods (default 0). Used to value the stock and its average price.
fields.id: Harga per satuan barang yang diterima (default 0). Dipakai untuk menilai stok dan harga rata-ratanya.

title: Stock Out - Finished Goods

purpose.en: View-only list of Finished Goods issue documents. Finished goods leave the warehouse through a Delivery Order, so this screen has no New Record or Open; use it to look up issues already recorded.
purpose.id: Daftar dokumen pengeluaran Barang Jadi yang hanya bisa dilihat. Barang jadi keluar lewat Delivery Order, jadi layar ini tidak punya New Record atau Open; pakai untuk mencari pengeluaran yang sudah tercatat.

keywords: stock out, barang keluar, pengeluaran, barang jadi, finished goods, fg, delivery order, do, pengiriman

steps.en: Type in the search box (document no, reference, notes) or use the Draft / Waiting / Posted tabs and column filters to narrow the list.
steps.id: Ketik di kotak cari (no dokumen, referensi, catatan) atau pakai tab Draft / Waiting / Posted dan filter kolom untuk mempersempit daftar.

steps.en: Expand a row to see its item lines: Code, Item Name, Qty, Unit and Lot No.
steps.id: Buka baris untuk melihat baris item: Code, Item Name, Qty, Unit dan Lot No.

steps.en: To send finished goods to a customer, create a Delivery Order in the Delivery menu instead; it is not entered here.
steps.id: Untuk mengirim barang jadi ke customer, buat Delivery Order di menu Delivery; tidak diinput di sini.

steps.en: To correct a finished goods balance, use Stock Adjustment & Physical Count - Finished Goods.
steps.id: Untuk mengoreksi saldo barang jadi, pakai Stock Adjustment & Physical Count - Finished Goods.

fields.label: Doc No. / Warehouse
fields.en: Document number with the warehouse it was issued from.
fields.id: Nomor dokumen beserta gudang asal pengeluaran.

fields.label: Date
fields.en: Document date.
fields.id: Tanggal dokumen.

fields.label: Category
fields.en: Document category code of the document.
fields.id: Kode kategori dokumen.

fields.label: Source
fields.en: Where the document came from (MANUAL when typed by hand, otherwise the type of the source document).
fields.id: Asal dokumen (MANUAL bila diketik, selain itu jenis dokumen sumbernya).

fields.label: Reference
fields.en: Number of the source document, if any.
fields.id: Nomor dokumen sumber, bila ada.

fields.label: Notes
fields.en: Remark written on the document.
fields.id: Catatan pada dokumen.

fields.label: Status
fields.en: Document status: Draft, waiting (Submitted / Confirmed / Approved), Posted or Cancelled.
fields.id: Status dokumen: Draft, menunggu (Submitted / Confirmed / Approved), Posted atau Cancelled.

title: Return from Production - Finished Goods

purpose.en: View-only list of Finished Goods return documents. Finished goods never leave through Stock Out, so there is nothing to return from production; this screen has no New Record or Open.
purpose.id: Daftar dokumen retur Barang Jadi yang hanya bisa dilihat. Barang jadi tidak pernah keluar lewat Stock Out, jadi tidak ada yang diretur dari produksi; layar ini tidak punya New Record atau Open.

keywords: return from production, retur produksi, retur, barang jadi, finished goods, fg, kembali ke gudang

steps.en: Type in the search box or use the Draft / Waiting / Posted tabs and column filters to find a document.
steps.id: Ketik di kotak cari atau pakai tab Draft / Waiting / Posted dan filter kolom untuk mencari dokumen.

steps.en: Expand a row to see its item lines: Code, Item Name, Qty, Unit and Lot No.
steps.id: Buka baris untuk melihat baris item: Code, Item Name, Qty, Unit dan Lot No.

steps.en: To bring back raw material or semi finished goods, use Return from Production in those stock menus.
steps.id: Untuk mengembalikan bahan baku atau barang setengah jadi, pakai Return from Production di menu stok tersebut.

fields.label: Doc No. / Warehouse
fields.en: Document number with the warehouse that received the goods.
fields.id: Nomor dokumen beserta gudang penerima barang.

fields.label: Date
fields.en: Document date.
fields.id: Tanggal dokumen.

fields.label: Category
fields.en: Document category code (RETURN).
fields.id: Kode kategori dokumen (RETURN).

fields.label: Source
fields.en: Type of the source document, or MANUAL.
fields.id: Jenis dokumen sumber, atau MANUAL.

fields.label: Reference
fields.en: Number of the Stock Out the return refers to.
fields.id: Nomor Stock Out yang diretur.

fields.label: Notes
fields.en: Remark written on the document.
fields.id: Catatan pada dokumen.

fields.label: Status
fields.en: Document status: Draft, waiting, Posted or Cancelled.
fields.id: Status dokumen: Draft, menunggu, Posted atau Cancelled.

title: Stock Adjustment & Physical Count - Finished Goods
title_id: Stock Adjustment & Hitung Fisik - Barang Jadi

purpose.en: Correct the system balance of Finished Goods to the real quantity: a single Adjustment, or a scheduled Stock Opname (physical count). It always needs approval; the stock only changes when the last approver approves.
purpose.id: Mengoreksi saldo sistem Barang Jadi agar sama dengan jumlah sebenarnya: Adjustment tunggal atau Stock Opname (hitung fisik) terjadwal. Selalu perlu persetujuan; stok baru berubah setelah approver terakhir menyetujui.

keywords: stock adjustment, opname, stock opname, hitung fisik, koreksi stok, selisih stok, penyesuaian stok, adj, op, ad, Finished Goods, Barang Jadi

steps.en: The list shows Adjustment and Opname documents of this stock class with their status. Search by document no or notes, or use the status tabs and filters.
steps.id: Daftar menampilkan dokumen Adjustment dan Opname kelas stok ini beserta statusnya. Cari dengan no dokumen atau catatan, atau pakai tab status dan filter.

steps.en: Click + New Record. Choose Kind (Adjustment or Stock Opname), Document Date, Warehouse and Reason. For Stock Opname also fill the Opname Block: officer, count start and end, witness.
steps.id: Klik + New Record. Pilih Kind (Adjustment atau Stock Opname), Document Date, Warehouse dan Reason. Untuk Stock Opname isi juga Blok Opname: petugas, mulai dan selesai hitung, saksi.

steps.en: Add lines: search the product (2 or more characters) and click it. For a full count tick Full Scope and click Pull All Items With Balance to load every item that has stock in the warehouse.
steps.id: Tambah baris: cari produk (2 huruf atau lebih) lalu klik. Untuk hitung penuh centang Full Scope dan klik Pull All Items With Balance untuk memuat semua item yang punya stok di gudang.

steps.en: On each line choose Location: System Balance and the price are loaded from the last Stock Card entry. Type the counted quantity in Physical Count; Variance and Variance Value are calculated.
steps.id: Di tiap baris pilih Location: System Balance dan harga dimuat dari catatan terakhir Kartu Stok. Ketik jumlah hasil hitung di Physical Count; Variance dan Variance Value dihitung otomatis.

steps.en: Click Save Draft. When the lines are final, click Submit for Approval. The lines are locked while approval runs.
steps.id: Klik Save Draft. Setelah baris final, klik Submit for Approval. Baris terkunci selama proses persetujuan.

steps.en: Approvers decide in Adjustment Approval. When the last level approves, the document is posted to the Stock Card. If rejected, the status becomes REVISION_NEEDED: fix it and submit again.
steps.id: Approver memutuskan di Adjustment Approval. Saat level terakhir menyetujui, dokumen diposting ke Kartu Stok. Bila ditolak, status menjadi REVISION_NEEDED: perbaiki lalu ajukan lagi.

fields.label: Document No.
fields.en: Filled by the system when the draft is first saved (ADJ for Adjustment, OPN for Opname).
fields.id: Diisi sistem saat draft pertama disimpan (ADJ untuk Adjustment, OPN untuk Opname).

fields.label: Document Date *
fields.en: Date of the correction or count. Required. Starts as today.
fields.id: Tanggal koreksi atau hitung. Wajib. Awalnya hari ini.

fields.label: Kind *
fields.en: Adjustment (single correction) or Stock Opname (scheduled physical count). Cannot be changed after the first save.
fields.id: Adjustment (koreksi tunggal) atau Stock Opname (hitung fisik terjadwal). Tidak bisa diubah setelah disimpan pertama kali.

fields.label: Warehouse *
fields.en: Warehouse being corrected or counted. Required.
fields.id: Gudang yang dikoreksi atau dihitung. Wajib.

fields.label: Reason *
fields.en: Why the balance differs: previous counting/input error, damaged, lost, found (more than recorded), expired or other. Required.
fields.id: Mengapa saldo berbeda: salah hitung/input sebelumnya, rusak, hilang, ditemukan (lebih dari catatan), kadaluarsa atau lainnya. Wajib.

fields.label: Submitted by
fields.en: Shows the logged-in user. Display only.
fields.id: Menampilkan user yang sedang login. Hanya tampilan.

fields.label: Opname Officer *
fields.en: Name of the person who counts. Required for Stock Opname only.
fields.id: Nama petugas yang menghitung. Wajib hanya untuk Stock Opname.

fields.label: Count Start *
fields.en: Date and time the count started. Required for Stock Opname.
fields.id: Tanggal dan jam hitung mulai. Wajib untuk Stock Opname.

fields.label: Count End *
fields.en: Date and time the count finished. Required for Stock Opname.
fields.id: Tanggal dan jam hitung selesai. Wajib untuk Stock Opname.

fields.label: Witness *
fields.en: Name of the person who witnesses the count. Required for Stock Opname.
fields.id: Nama saksi hitung. Wajib untuk Stock Opname.

fields.label: Full Scope (all items with balance)
fields.en: Tick when every item in the warehouse is counted; it shows the button Pull All Items With Balance that loads all items with a balance. Stock Opname only.
fields.id: Centang bila semua item di gudang dihitung; muncul tombol Pull All Items With Balance yang memuat semua item bersaldo. Hanya Stock Opname.

fields.label: Notes / Chronology
fields.en: Free text: what happened and how the difference was found.
fields.id: Teks bebas: apa yang terjadi dan bagaimana selisih ditemukan.

fields.label: Location *
fields.en: Location of the counted stock. Choosing it loads System Balance and the price for that item and location. Required.
fields.id: Lokasi stok yang dihitung. Memilihnya memuat System Balance dan harga item di lokasi itu. Wajib.

fields.label: System Balance
fields.en: Quantity the system says is there (from the last Stock Card entry). Display only.
fields.id: Jumlah menurut sistem (dari catatan terakhir Kartu Stok). Hanya tampilan.

fields.label: Physical Count *
fields.en: The real quantity counted, zero or more. Type the counted total, not the difference. Required.
fields.id: Jumlah nyata hasil hitung, nol atau lebih. Ketik total hasil hitung, bukan selisihnya. Wajib.

fields.label: Variance
fields.en: Physical Count minus System Balance, calculated. Plus means more than recorded, minus means less.
fields.id: Physical Count dikurangi System Balance, dihitung otomatis. Plus berarti lebih dari catatan, minus berarti kurang.

fields.label: Variance Value
fields.en: Absolute value of the variance times the unit price, calculated. The total decides how many approval levels are needed.
fields.id: Nilai mutlak selisih dikali harga satuan, dihitung otomatis. Totalnya menentukan jumlah level persetujuan.

fields.label: Line Reason
fields.en: Remark per line; the screen marks it required when there is a variance. It is a reminder on the screen and is not saved with the document.
fields.id: Catatan per baris; layar menandainya wajib bila ada selisih. Hanya pengingat di layar dan tidak disimpan bersama dokumen.

fields.label: Rejection Reason
fields.en: Shown to the approver only: required when rejecting, at least 10 characters.
fields.id: Hanya untuk approver: wajib saat menolak, minimal 10 karakter.

title: Stock Balance - Finished Goods

purpose.en: Shows how much Finished Goods is on hand now, one row per item and location, with this month's opening, in, out and adjustment. Open it to check stock, value and items below minimum.
purpose.id: Menampilkan jumlah Barang Jadi yang ada sekarang, satu baris per item dan lokasi, beserta awal, masuk, keluar dan penyesuaian bulan ini. Buka untuk cek stok, nilai dan item di bawah minimum.

keywords: stock balance, saldo stok, stok, on hand, persediaan, master stock, minimum stock, stok minimum, nilai stok, laporan stok, Finished Goods, Barang Jadi

steps.en: Open the report; it lists all stock now. Type in the search box (item code or name) to find an item.
steps.id: Buka laporan; isinya semua stok saat ini. Ketik di kotak cari (kode atau nama item) untuk menemukan item.

steps.en: Click a tab (Below minimum, Empty, Not usable) to see only those rows, or All to see everything.
steps.id: Klik tab (Below minimum, Empty, Not usable) untuk melihat baris tertentu saja, atau All untuk semuanya.

steps.en: Use the filters Category, Warehouse, Location and Stock to narrow the list.
steps.id: Pakai filter Category, Warehouse, Location dan Stock untuk mempersempit daftar.

steps.en: Group by Category, Warehouse or Item to get subtotals. Number and value columns show totals.
steps.id: Kelompokkan menurut Category, Warehouse atau Item untuk mendapat subtotal. Kolom jumlah dan nilai menampilkan total.

steps.en: Use the column chooser to show Minimum Stock and Idle (days), which are hidden at first. Open the Stock Card report to see the movements behind a balance.
steps.id: Pakai pemilih kolom untuk menampilkan Minimum Stock dan Idle (days) yang awalnya tersembunyi. Buka laporan Stock Card untuk melihat mutasi di balik saldo.

fields.label: Item
fields.en: Item name with its code.
fields.id: Nama item beserta kodenya.

fields.label: Category
fields.en: Group of the item: the product category.
fields.id: Kelompok item: kategori produk.

fields.label: Warehouse
fields.en: Warehouse holding the stock.
fields.id: Gudang tempat stok berada.

fields.label: Location
fields.en: Storage location (bin) in that warehouse.
fields.id: Lokasi simpan (bin) di gudang itu.

fields.label: Opening
fields.en: Quantity at the start of the current month. If the item had no movement this month it equals On Hand.
fields.id: Jumlah di awal bulan berjalan. Bila item tidak bergerak bulan ini, nilainya sama dengan On Hand.

fields.label: In
fields.en: Total received this month.
fields.id: Total masuk bulan ini.

fields.label: Out
fields.en: Total issued this month.
fields.id: Total keluar bulan ini.

fields.label: Adjustment
fields.en: Total of adjustments and opname corrections this month (can be negative).
fields.id: Total penyesuaian dan koreksi opname bulan ini (bisa negatif).

fields.label: On Hand
fields.en: Quantity in the warehouse now.
fields.id: Jumlah di gudang sekarang.

fields.label: Unit
fields.en: Stock unit.
fields.id: Satuan stok.

fields.label: Minimum Stock
fields.en: Minimum stock set on the item master. Hidden at first.
fields.id: Stok minimum yang diatur di master item. Awalnya tersembunyi.

fields.label: Stock Value
fields.en: Value of the stock in that row.
fields.id: Nilai stok pada baris itu.

fields.label: Last Movement
fields.en: Date of the latest movement of that item in that location.
fields.id: Tanggal mutasi terakhir item di lokasi itu.

fields.label: Idle (days)
fields.en: Days since the last movement. Hidden at first.
fields.id: Jumlah hari sejak mutasi terakhir. Awalnya tersembunyi.

fields.label: Stock
fields.en: Status: OK, Below minimum (usable stock of the item is under its minimum), Empty, or Not usable (location cannot be used, e.g. waste).
fields.id: Status: OK, Below minimum (stok bisa pakai item di bawah minimum), Empty, atau Not usable (lokasi tidak bisa dipakai, mis. waste).

fields.label: Filter: Category / Warehouse / Location / Stock
fields.en: Narrow the rows by item group, warehouse, location or stock status.
fields.id: Mempersempit baris menurut kelompok item, gudang, lokasi atau status stok.

fields.label: Group by: Category / Warehouse / Item
fields.en: Gather the rows under headings with subtotals.
fields.id: Mengelompokkan baris di bawah judul dengan subtotal.

title: Stock Card - Finished Goods

purpose.en: Lists every stock movement of Finished Goods, newest first: what came in, went out or was adjusted, in which document and location, and the balance after it. Open it to trace why a balance is what it is.
purpose.id: Menampilkan setiap mutasi stok Barang Jadi, terbaru di atas: apa yang masuk, keluar atau disesuaikan, di dokumen dan lokasi mana, serta saldo sesudahnya. Buka untuk menelusuri asal sebuah saldo.

keywords: stock card, kartu stok, mutasi stok, riwayat stok, movement, history stok, kartu persediaan, laporan stok, Finished Goods, Barang Jadi

steps.en: Open the report; all movements are listed, newest first.
steps.id: Buka laporan; semua mutasi tampil, terbaru di atas.

steps.en: To read the card of one item, type its code or name (or a document or reference number) in the search box, or group by Item.
steps.id: Untuk membaca kartu satu item, ketik kode atau namanya (atau no dokumen atau referensi) di kotak cari, atau kelompokkan menurut Item.

steps.en: Click a tab (In, Out, Adjustment) to see only that kind of movement.
steps.id: Klik tab (In, Out, Adjustment) untuk melihat satu jenis mutasi saja.

steps.en: Use the filters Movement, Category, Warehouse and Location, or group by Warehouse or Movement.
steps.id: Pakai filter Movement, Category, Warehouse dan Location, atau kelompokkan menurut Warehouse atau Movement.

steps.en: Read BB, the movement and EB on the same row. BB is the balance of the item in all locations before the row; EB is BB + In - Out + Adjustment and is the BB of the next row.
steps.id: Baca BB, mutasi dan EB pada baris yang sama. BB = saldo item di semua lokasi sebelum baris; EB = BB + In - Out + Adjustment dan menjadi BB baris berikutnya.

fields.label: Date
fields.en: Date of the document.
fields.id: Tanggal dokumen.

fields.label: Doc No.
fields.en: Number of the stock document that caused the movement.
fields.id: Nomor dokumen stok yang menyebabkan mutasi.

fields.label: Movement
fields.en: Kind of movement: In, Out, Adjustment, Transfer in, Transfer out or Opening.
fields.id: Jenis mutasi: In, Out, Adjustment, Transfer in, Transfer out, atau Opening.

fields.label: Category
fields.en: Document category code (for example STOCK, BB, AD, OP, RETURN). Hidden at first.
fields.id: Kode kategori dokumen (misalnya STOCK, BB, AD, OP, RETURN). Awalnya tersembunyi.

fields.label: Item
fields.en: Item name with its code.
fields.id: Nama item beserta kodenya.

fields.label: Warehouse
fields.en: Warehouse of the movement.
fields.id: Gudang tempat mutasi.

fields.label: Location
fields.en: Storage location (bin).
fields.id: Lokasi simpan (bin).

fields.label: Lot No.
fields.en: Lot or batch number. Hidden at first.
fields.id: Nomor lot atau batch. Awalnya tersembunyi.

fields.label: Reference
fields.en: Number of the source document, for example the receiving or the Stock Out it came from.
fields.id: Nomor dokumen sumber, misalnya penerimaan atau Stock Out asalnya.

fields.label: BB
fields.en: Balance of the item in all locations just before the movement. It equals the EB of the row before it.
fields.id: Saldo item di semua lokasi tepat sebelum mutasi. Sama dengan EB baris sebelumnya.

fields.label: In
fields.en: Quantity received.
fields.id: Jumlah masuk.

fields.label: Out
fields.en: Quantity issued.
fields.id: Jumlah keluar.

fields.label: Adjustment
fields.en: Quantity added or removed by an adjustment (can be negative).
fields.id: Jumlah yang ditambah atau dikurangi oleh penyesuaian (bisa negatif).

fields.label: EB
fields.en: Balance of the item in all locations right after the movement: BB + In - Out + Adjustment.
fields.id: Saldo item di semua lokasi sesudah mutasi: BB + In - Out + Adjustment.

fields.label: Location Opening
fields.en: Balance of that item in that one location just before the movement. Hidden at first.
fields.id: Saldo item di satu lokasi itu tepat sebelum mutasi. Awalnya tersembunyi.

fields.label: Location Balance
fields.en: Balance of that item in that one location right after the movement. Hidden at first.
fields.id: Saldo item di satu lokasi itu sesudah mutasi. Awalnya tersembunyi.

fields.label: Unit
fields.en: Stock unit.
fields.id: Satuan stok.

fields.label: Filter: Movement / Category / Warehouse / Location
fields.en: Narrow the rows by kind of movement, document category, warehouse or location.
fields.id: Mempersempit baris menurut jenis mutasi, kategori dokumen, gudang atau lokasi.

fields.label: Group by: Item / Warehouse / Movement
fields.en: Gather the rows under headings. Group by Item to read one item as a card.
fields.id: Mengelompokkan baris di bawah judul. Kelompokkan menurut Item untuk membaca satu item sebagai kartu.

title: Slow Moving Item - Finished Goods

purpose.en: Lists Finished Goods items that still have usable stock but have not moved for 3 months or more, so you can decide to use, sell or write them off. Open it during stock review.
purpose.id: Menampilkan item Barang Jadi yang masih punya stok bisa pakai tetapi tidak bergerak 3 bulan atau lebih, agar bisa diputuskan dipakai, dijual atau dihapus. Buka saat evaluasi stok.

keywords: slow moving, slow moving item, stok mati, barang tidak bergerak, dead stock, stok lama, idle, tidak laku, laporan stok, Finished Goods, Barang Jadi

steps.en: Open the report; items with no movement for 3 months or more are listed, longest idle first.
steps.id: Buka laporan; item yang tidak bergerak 3 bulan atau lebih tampil, yang paling lama diam di atas.

steps.en: Click a tab (3-6 months, 6-9 months, 9-12 months, Over 12 months, Never moved) to see one age band.
steps.id: Klik tab (3-6 months, 6-9 months, 9-12 months, Over 12 months, Never moved) untuk melihat satu rentang usia.

steps.en: Use the search box (item code or name), the filters Category and Idle, or group by Category or Idle.
steps.id: Pakai kotak cari (kode atau nama item), filter Category dan Idle, atau kelompokkan menurut Category atau Idle.

steps.en: Check On Hand, Stock Value and Last Movement, then follow up with the warehouse or purchasing. The totals show how much value is tied up.
steps.id: Cek On Hand, Stock Value dan Last Movement, lalu tindak lanjuti bersama gudang atau pembelian. Total menunjukkan nilai yang tertahan.

fields.label: Item
fields.en: Item name with its code. Each item appears once, even when it is in several locations.
fields.id: Nama item beserta kodenya. Tiap item tampil sekali, walau ada di beberapa lokasi.

fields.label: Category
fields.en: Group of the item: the product category.
fields.id: Kelompok item: kategori produk.

fields.label: Warehouse
fields.en: All warehouses where the item has usable stock.
fields.id: Semua gudang tempat item punya stok bisa pakai.

fields.label: On Hand
fields.en: Total usable quantity of the item.
fields.id: Total jumlah item yang bisa dipakai.

fields.label: Unit
fields.en: Stock unit.
fields.id: Satuan stok.

fields.label: Stock Value
fields.en: Value of that stock.
fields.id: Nilai stok itu.

fields.label: Last Movement
fields.en: Date of the latest movement of the item in any location. Empty for old balances without a date.
fields.id: Tanggal mutasi terakhir item di lokasi mana pun. Kosong untuk saldo lama tanpa tanggal.

fields.label: Idle (days)
fields.en: Days since the last movement.
fields.id: Jumlah hari sejak mutasi terakhir.

fields.label: Idle
fields.en: Age band: 3-6 months, 6-9 months, 9-12 months, Over 12 months, or Never moved (old balance without a movement date).
fields.id: Rentang usia: 3-6 months, 6-9 months, 9-12 months, Over 12 months, atau Never moved (saldo lama tanpa tanggal mutasi).

fields.label: Filter: Category / Idle
fields.en: Narrow the rows by item group or age band.
fields.id: Mempersempit baris menurut kelompok item atau rentang usia.

fields.label: Group by: Category / Idle
fields.en: Gather the rows under headings with subtotals.
fields.id: Mengelompokkan baris di bawah judul dengan subtotal.

title: Stock In - Semi Finished Goods

purpose.en: Record Semi Finished Goods goods coming into a warehouse (regular receipt or opening balance) and post them to the Stock Card. Open it when goods arrive or to load an opening balance. Documents here are entered by hand (Source MANUAL).
purpose.id: Mencatat Barang Setengah Jadi yang masuk ke gudang (penerimaan biasa atau saldo awal) lalu memostingnya ke Kartu Stok. Buka saat barang datang atau memuat saldo awal. Dokumen di sini diinput manual (Sumber MANUAL).

keywords: stock in, barang masuk, penerimaan, saldo awal, opening balance, bb, in, Semi Finished Goods, Barang Setengah Jadi, setengah jadi, semi finished goods, sfg, wip

steps.en: The list shows Stock In documents of Semi Finished Goods. Use the search box (document no, reference, notes), the Draft / Waiting / Posted tabs or the column filters to find one.
steps.id: Daftar menampilkan dokumen Stock In Barang Setengah Jadi. Pakai kotak cari (no dokumen, referensi, catatan), tab Draft / Waiting / Posted atau filter kolom untuk mencarinya.

steps.en: Click + New Record to open an empty document. To change an existing draft, double-click its row or click Open.
steps.id: Klik + New Record untuk membuka dokumen kosong. Untuk mengubah draft yang ada, klik 2x barisnya atau klik Open.

steps.en: Fill Document Date, Document Category and Warehouse. Pick the Warehouse before the lines: the Location list of each line shows only usable locations of that warehouse.
steps.id: Isi Document Date, Document Category dan Warehouse. Pilih Warehouse sebelum baris item: daftar Location tiap baris hanya berisi lokasi yang bisa dipakai di gudang itu.

steps.en: Type at least 2 characters of the code or name in the item search box and click the result to add a line (the part comes from the Master Card). Repeat for every item.
steps.id: Ketik minimal 2 huruf kode atau nama di kotak cari item lalu klik hasilnya untuk menambah baris (part diambil dari Master Card). Ulangi untuk tiap item.

steps.en: On each line choose Location, enter Qty and, if needed, pick a Batch or choose + New batch and fill Supplier Lot and dates. Fill Unit Price. UoM is filled from the item.
steps.id: Di tiap baris pilih Location, isi Qty, dan bila perlu pilih Batch atau pilih + New batch lalu isi Supplier Lot dan tanggal. Isi Unit Price. UoM terisi dari item.

steps.en: Click Save Draft. The system gives the document its number. You can still edit the draft; Cancel cancels it.
steps.id: Klik Save Draft. Sistem memberi nomor dokumen. Draft masih bisa diubah; Cancel membatalkannya.

steps.en: Open the draft and click Confirm & Post (or the check icon in the list). The goods are added to the Stock Card and the document becomes read-only; fix mistakes later with a Stock Adjustment.
steps.id: Buka draft lalu klik Confirm & Post (atau ikon centang di daftar). Barang masuk ke Kartu Stok dan dokumen jadi hanya-baca; kesalahan dikoreksi lewat Stock Adjustment.

fields.label: Document No.
fields.en: Filled by the system when the draft is first saved. Not typed.
fields.id: Diisi sistem saat draft pertama disimpan. Tidak diketik.

fields.label: Document Date *
fields.en: Date the goods are received. Required. Starts as today.
fields.id: Tanggal barang diterima. Wajib. Awalnya hari ini.

fields.label: Document Category *
fields.en: STOCK (regular receipt) for normal incoming goods, BB (opening balance) to load the starting stock of an item. Required.
fields.id: STOCK (masuk biasa) untuk barang masuk normal, BB (saldo awal) untuk memuat stok awal item. Wajib.

fields.label: Warehouse *
fields.en: Receiving warehouse, picked from active warehouses in Warehouse & Location. Required. It decides which locations the lines can use.
fields.id: Gudang penerima, dipilih dari gudang aktif di Warehouse & Location. Wajib. Menentukan lokasi yang bisa dipakai baris.

fields.label: Received by
fields.en: Shows the logged-in user. Display only.
fields.id: Menampilkan user yang sedang login. Hanya tampilan.

fields.label: Notes
fields.en: Free text, for example delivery note number or remark. Shown under the document number in the list.
fields.id: Teks bebas, misalnya nomor surat jalan atau catatan. Tampil di bawah nomor dokumen pada daftar.

fields.label: Search item code / name to add…
fields.en: Search box to add a line. Type 2 or more characters; only active items of the Master Card are found (max 15 results).
fields.id: Kotak cari untuk menambah baris. Ketik 2 huruf atau lebih; hanya item aktif dari Master Card yang ditemukan (maks 15 hasil).

fields.label: Batch
fields.en: Optional. Pick an existing batch of the item (batch no, supplier lot, expiry) or + New batch. An item with a shelf life needs the expiry date of a new batch. The Stock Card keeps the lot.
fields.id: Opsional. Pilih batch item yang ada (no batch, lot supplier, kedaluwarsa) atau + New batch. Item berumur simpan wajib diisi tanggal kedaluwarsa batch baru. Kartu Stok menyimpan lotnya.

fields.label: Location *
fields.en: Storage location (bin) in the chosen warehouse where the goods are put. Required for every line.
fields.id: Lokasi simpan (bin) di gudang terpilih tempat barang ditaruh. Wajib di setiap baris.

fields.label: Qty *
fields.en: Quantity received, must be more than zero. Required.
fields.id: Jumlah yang diterima, harus lebih dari nol. Wajib.

fields.label: UoM
fields.en: Stock unit of the item, filled automatically.
fields.id: Satuan stok item, terisi otomatis.

fields.label: Unit Price
fields.en: Price per unit of the received goods (default 0). Used to value the stock and its average price.
fields.id: Harga per satuan barang yang diterima (default 0). Dipakai untuk menilai stok dan harga rata-ratanya.

title: Stock Out - Semi Finished Goods

purpose.en: Record Semi Finished Goods issued out of a warehouse to a department or process (for example to production) and post it to the Stock Card. Open it when goods are handed over from the warehouse.
purpose.id: Mencatat Barang Setengah Jadi yang dikeluarkan dari gudang ke departemen atau proses (misalnya ke produksi) lalu memostingnya ke Kartu Stok. Buka saat barang diserahkan dari gudang.

keywords: stock out, barang keluar, pengeluaran, issue, serah terima, ke produksi, out, Semi Finished Goods, Barang Setengah Jadi, setengah jadi, semi finished goods, sfg, wip

steps.en: The list shows Stock Out documents of this stock class. Search by document no or notes, or use the Draft / Waiting / Posted tabs and column filters.
steps.id: Daftar menampilkan dokumen Stock Out kelas stok ini. Cari dengan no dokumen atau catatan, atau pakai tab Draft / Waiting / Posted dan filter kolom.

steps.en: Click + New Record (or double-click a draft to edit it).
steps.id: Klik + New Record (atau klik 2x draft untuk mengubahnya).

steps.en: Fill Document Date, Source Warehouse and Issued To (Dept.). Target Process is optional text. Pick the warehouse first so the line locations can be chosen.
steps.id: Isi Document Date, Source Warehouse dan Issued To (Dept.). Target Process teks opsional. Pilih gudang dulu agar lokasi baris bisa dipilih.

steps.en: Search the part by code or name (2 or more characters) and click the result to add a line; repeat for each item.
steps.id: Cari part dengan kode atau nama (2 huruf atau lebih) lalu klik hasilnya untuk menambah baris; ulangi untuk tiap item.

steps.en: For each line choose Source Location and enter Qty Out and, if needed, Lot/Batch.
steps.id: Di tiap baris pilih Source Location dan isi Qty Out, serta Lot/Batch bila perlu.

steps.en: Click Save Draft, then open the draft and click Confirm & Post (or the check icon in the list). The goods leave the Stock Card and the document becomes read-only.
steps.id: Klik Save Draft, lalu buka draft dan klik Confirm & Post (atau ikon centang di daftar). Barang keluar dari Kartu Stok dan dokumen jadi hanya-baca.

steps.en: If the item has no cost/inventory account, a notice tells you which master to complete. Wrong document? Cancel a draft, or correct a posted one with Stock Adjustment.
steps.id: Bila item belum punya akun HPP/persediaan, muncul peringatan master mana yang harus dilengkapi. Salah dokumen? Cancel draft, atau koreksi yang sudah posting lewat Stock Adjustment.

fields.label: Document No.
fields.en: Filled by the system when the draft is first saved.
fields.id: Diisi sistem saat draft pertama disimpan.

fields.label: Document Date *
fields.en: Date the goods are issued. Required. Starts as today.
fields.id: Tanggal barang dikeluarkan. Wajib. Awalnya hari ini.

fields.label: Source Warehouse *
fields.en: Warehouse the goods are taken from, picked from active warehouses. Required.
fields.id: Gudang asal barang, dipilih dari gudang aktif. Wajib.

fields.label: Issued To (Dept.) *
fields.en: Department that receives the goods, picked from the department master. Required.
fields.id: Departemen penerima barang, dipilih dari master departemen. Wajib.

fields.label: Target Process
fields.en: Free text for the process the goods go to, for example Offset Printing or Lamination. Optional.
fields.id: Teks bebas untuk proses tujuan barang, misalnya Cetak Offset atau Laminasi. Opsional.

fields.label: Issued by
fields.en: Shows the logged-in user. Display only.
fields.id: Menampilkan user yang sedang login. Hanya tampilan.

fields.label: Notes
fields.en: Free text remark, shown under the document number in the list.
fields.id: Catatan bebas, tampil di bawah nomor dokumen pada daftar.

fields.label: Search code / name of part to add…
fields.en: Search box to add a line. Type 2 or more characters; only active items of the Master Card are found.
fields.id: Kotak cari untuk menambah baris. Ketik 2 huruf atau lebih; hanya item aktif dari Master Card yang ditemukan.

fields.label: Lot/Batch
fields.en: Optional lot or batch number of the goods taken.
fields.id: Nomor lot atau batch barang yang diambil (opsional).

fields.label: Source Location *
fields.en: Storage location (bin) the goods are taken from, limited to usable locations of the source warehouse. Required.
fields.id: Lokasi simpan (bin) asal barang, terbatas pada lokasi yang bisa dipakai di gudang sumber. Wajib.

fields.label: Qty Out *
fields.en: Quantity issued, must be more than zero. Required.
fields.id: Jumlah yang dikeluarkan, harus lebih dari nol. Wajib.

fields.label: UoM
fields.en: Stock unit of the item, filled automatically.
fields.id: Satuan stok item, terisi otomatis.

title: Return from Production - Semi Finished Goods
title_id: Retur dari Produksi - Barang Setengah Jadi

purpose.en: Bring Semi Finished Goods back to the warehouse after production did not use it, either in good condition or as scrap. A return always refers to a posted Stock Out and can never be more than what is left of it.
purpose.id: Mengembalikan Barang Setengah Jadi ke gudang setelah produksi tidak memakainya, dalam kondisi layak atau afkir. Retur selalu mengacu ke Stock Out yang sudah posting dan tidak boleh melebihi sisanya.

keywords: return from production, retur produksi, retur, kembali ke gudang, afkir, scrap, sisa bahan, Semi Finished Goods, Barang Setengah Jadi, setengah jadi, semi finished goods, sfg, wip

steps.en: The list shows return documents of this stock class. Search by document no or Stock Out no, or use the Draft / Waiting / Posted tabs and column filters.
steps.id: Daftar menampilkan dokumen retur kelas stok ini. Cari dengan no dokumen atau no Stock Out, atau pakai tab Draft / Waiting / Posted dan filter kolom.

steps.en: Click + New Record. Fill Tanggal Dokumen and click the dashed Ref. Stock Out box to open the list of Stock Out documents that can still be returned.
steps.id: Klik + New Record. Isi Tanggal Dokumen lalu klik kotak putus-putus Ref. Stock Out untuk membuka daftar Stock Out yang masih bisa diretur.

steps.en: Click a Stock Out. Its lines are copied in with Dikeluarkan and Sisa Boleh (what may still be returned). Choose Gudang Purpose (bahan layak).
steps.id: Klik satu Stock Out. Baris-barisnya disalin lengkap dengan Dikeluarkan dan Sisa Boleh (yang masih boleh diretur). Pilih Gudang Purpose (bahan layak).

steps.en: On each line enter Qty Retur, choose Kondisi (GOOD or SCRAP) and Lokasi Purpose. Lines you do not return must not stay with a quantity.
steps.id: Di tiap baris isi Qty Retur, pilih Kondisi (GOOD atau SCRAP) dan Lokasi Purpose. Baris yang tidak diretur jangan dibiarkan berisi jumlah.

steps.en: For SCRAP lines Keterangan is required. Click Save Draft, then open the draft and click Confirm & Post.
steps.id: Untuk baris SCRAP, Keterangan wajib diisi. Klik Save Draft, lalu buka draft dan klik Confirm & Post.

steps.en: After posting the goods are added back to the Stock Card and the returned quantity is counted on the Stock Out. The document is read-only; Cancel works only on a draft.
steps.id: Setelah posting barang masuk lagi ke Kartu Stok dan jumlah retur tercatat di Stock Out. Dokumen jadi hanya-baca; Cancel hanya untuk draft.

fields.label: Doc No.
fields.en: Filled by the system when the draft is first saved.
fields.id: Diisi sistem saat draft pertama disimpan.

fields.label: Document Date *
fields.en: Date of the return. Required. Starts as today.
fields.id: Tanggal retur. Wajib. Awalnya hari ini.

fields.label: Ref. Stock Out *
fields.en: The posted, not cancelled Stock Out being returned, picked from the list of Stock Outs with a remaining returnable quantity. Fixed once saved. Required.
fields.id: Stock Out yang sudah posting dan tidak dibatalkan yang diretur, dipilih dari daftar Stock Out yang masih punya sisa retur. Tidak bisa diganti setelah disimpan. Wajib.

fields.label: Destination Warehouse (usable goods) *
fields.en: Warehouse that receives the returned goods. Good-condition lines can only use its usable locations. Required.
fields.id: Gudang penerima barang retur. Baris kondisi layak hanya bisa memakai lokasi yang bisa dipakai di gudang ini. Wajib.

fields.label: Source Process
fields.en: Process the goods came back from. Filled from the Stock Out, can be changed. Optional.
fields.id: Proses asal barang kembali. Terisi dari Stock Out, bisa diubah. Opsional.

fields.label: Notes
fields.en: Free text remark.
fields.id: Catatan bebas.

fields.label: Item
fields.en: Item of the line, copied from the Stock Out.
fields.id: Item baris, disalin dari Stock Out.

fields.label: Issued
fields.en: Quantity issued on the Stock Out line.
fields.id: Jumlah yang dikeluarkan pada baris Stock Out.

fields.label: Returnable
fields.en: Quantity that may still be returned (issued minus earlier returns). Qty Retur cannot go above it.
fields.id: Jumlah yang masih boleh diretur (dikeluarkan dikurangi retur sebelumnya). Qty Retur tidak boleh melebihinya.

fields.label: Return Qty *
fields.en: Quantity coming back, more than zero and not above Sisa Boleh. Required. The row turns red when too high.
fields.id: Jumlah yang kembali, lebih dari nol dan tidak lebih dari Sisa Boleh. Wajib. Baris menjadi merah bila kelebihan.

fields.label: Condition *
fields.en: GOOD (Layak) goes back to a usable location. SCRAP (Afkir) goes to a location that is not usable, for example a waste bin.
fields.id: GOOD (Layak) kembali ke lokasi yang bisa dipakai. SCRAP (Afkir) ke lokasi yang tidak bisa dipakai, misalnya bin waste.

fields.label: Destination Location *
fields.en: Location that receives the goods. The list changes with Kondisi. Required.
fields.id: Lokasi penerima barang. Daftarnya berubah sesuai Kondisi. Wajib.

fields.label: Description
